ctx.x: I think I conducted two. But I didn't conduct the first one downtown. But after the first one... Rube Bloom, I think he had something to do with it -- he was one of the writers. They had the idea of making the show look like a Broadway show. And they decided to write me out of the show, which I was written into the other show...write me out of the show...
